extensions.source: ../DESIGN.md; tagmaster/TMTheme.swift, TMRootController.swift, DPTagViewController.m, DPTagPageControllerBase.m, DPHomeViewController.m, DPFavoritesViewController.m, DPTeachableTagsController.m, DPTagCell.m

nativeColors.customAppearance: Ink, tint and affirmative resolve light/dark only; no increased-contrast branch.

wordmark.purpose: 24pt base scaled by UIFontMetrics for headline; system semibold fallback.

breakpoints.name: detail-split
breakpoints.value: 760pt minimum view width, regular horizontal size class, non-accessibility text category

nativeLayout.detailContentCap: 700pt outer padded width; full-width preference priority 999
nativeLayout.tagRow: Automatic height; 60pt minimum, 8pt top/bottom, 4pt stack spacing; table estimate 64pt. Native iPhone example 61pt default / 303pt accessibility XXXL, long-title example 561pt.
nativeLayout.savedLists: One readable-width column. Home has two peer disclosure rows with counts regardless of 0/1/100 memberships; each pushes its own list.
nativeLayout.largeText: Field rows and rating stack; material pushes in one column. Labeled native collection menus at all sizes.

motion.name: saved-feedback
motion.purpose: Native saved-state feedback; no custom duration.

motion.name: selection-feedback
motion.purpose: Native selection feedback; no custom duration.

extensions.nativeAssets: Original screenbackground.png untouched in light, white template in dark; original raster alpha only. Page-scale aspectFit, one pole per workspace.
extensions.plannedOrganization: Future only: multiple labels per tag and more named lists. Current code adds no labels UI, generic model, migrations, storage keys or sync fields.
extensions.densityEvidence: ../../../.impeccable/review/density/ios-report.md; synthetic native simulator captures, not live catalog or account data.
extensions.rendering: Native descriptions only. No web component previews or synthesized tonal ramps.

components.name: Home action row
components.description: Plain automatic-height discovery rows, then Your lists with exactly two peer disclosure entries, Favorites and Teachable Tags, each with a live count. No inline feeds or Home Edit.

components.name: Saved list destination
components.description: Separate Favorites and Teachable Tags plain tables with native Edit/Done, reorder, removal and empty states. Memberships and ordering remain independent. Full pole and native Back remain.

components.name: Compact tag row
components.description: DPTagCell shared by Browse/search and saved lists. Unlimited-line headline, distinct alternate title, footnote ID/material availability. Read-only status, not toggles. Rating stays on Summary; downloads and posted date stay on Details.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Minimal UISearchBar with title-or-lyrics accessibility label and Search return key.

components.name: Search action
components.description: Filled UIButton.Configuration with 12pt vertical and 16pt horizontal insets, 44pt minimum target.

components.name: Adaptive choice
components.description: Labeled native UIMenu button at every text size.

components.name: Root navigation
components.description: One UINavigationController: Home pushes Browse/Search, then tag, then material. Native Back to caller.

components.name: Tag sections
components.description: Summary workspace with Learning Tracks, Details, Videos pushes. Wide regular non-accessibility layout retains summary alongside material.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: TMEmptyStateView combines symbol, multiline title and message with an optional native recovery button.

narrative.overview: Handwritten wordmark, native system text, blue/charcoal and the actual original full-page barber pole. One native navigation stack.
keyCharacteristics: Handwriting for identity, native semantic type for reading and controls.
Blue actions over the original page-scale pole.
Readable panes and explicit large-text alternatives.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Resolve native semantic colors at use time; do not replace them with sampled light-mode hex values.

rules.name: The Native Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep handwriting in identity and use preferred UIKit text styles for reading and controls.

rules.name: The Readable Pane Rule
rules.body: Use available window width and text category, not device identity, to choose detail layout.

dos: Do preserve Home, Browse, Search, Favorites, Teachable Tags, Summary, Details, Tracks and Videos terminology alongside BarbershopTags.com attribution.
Do preserve semantic text colors and large-text menu, field-row and rating alternatives.
donts: Don't import Pitch Perfect's visual rules into Tag Master.
Don't canonize isolated legacy styling or unsampled shared-library internals as reusable system rules.
Do not restore global tabs, a sidebar, local tag tabs, or a footer-only pole.
